evidence.method: transform restated from the regular 1-D coordinates; CRS restated from the source
evidence.crs_from: the source COGs (ausantarctic/bedmap/bedmap3/cog/<array>.tif) declare EPSG:3031 (WGS 84 / Antarctic Polar Stereographic), origin -3333500, 3333500, cell 500 m, 13334 x 13334, AREA_OR_POINT=Area (gdal.Open on each COG, GDAL 3.13.3, PROJ 9.9.0, 2026-11-28). py/bedmap3_cog.py writes EPSG:3031 into each COG (outputSRS). bedmap3.nc (UK Polar Data Centre, doi:10.5285/2d0e4791-8e20-46a3-80e4-f5f6716025d2) states the same: global attribute crs = EPSG:3031 and a CF polar_stereographic grid mapping (latitude_of_projection_origin -90, standard_parallel -71, straight_vertical_longitude_from_pole 0) that GDAL reads as EPSG:3031
evidence.note: overview levels (<array>_x<f>, byterefs decision 0006) have no documents of their own: py/assertions.py applies this assertion scaled to each level
